SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT customers.id) AS "customers.n",
  COUNT(*) AS "customers.rows"
FROM customers AS customers
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM (
      SELECT
        customers.id AS id
    ) AS __slayer_spine
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON __slayer_spine.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      (
        customers.tier = 'bronze' OR orders.status = 'ok'
      )
  )
LIMIT 21
